sentence: Passengers waiting for the airport bus should stand near stop six.
setupText: Choose what the message asks the travellers to do.
taskText: Passengers waiting for the airport bus should stand near stop six.
text: Choose what the message asks the travellers to do. Passengers waiting for the airport bus should stand near stop six.
options: Wait inside the airport after the bus arrives.
Leave stop six to look for a different bus.
Move to stop six if waiting for the airport bus.
Ask the airport bus driver to wait at another stop.
answer: Move to stop six if waiting for the airport bus.
focusKey: coverage-reduced-clauses-a2-2901:Separating a descriptive ing phrase from the main instruction
explanation: Waiting for the airport bus identifies the passengers, and should stand near stop six gives their instruction.

rationales.Wait inside the airport after the bus ar: Waiting for identifies passengers before their bus arrives; the instruction locates them at stop six.
rationales.Move to stop six if waiting for the airp: Waiting for the airport bus identifies the passengers, and should stand near stop six gives their instruction.
rationales.Leave stop six to look for a different b: The message directs the identified passengers towards stop six, not away from it.
rationales.Ask the airport bus driver to wait at an: The passengers receive the instruction; it does not ask the driver to change stops.

rationales.Bags kept beside their owners: Owners beside their bags are nearby, the opposite of the defining condition.
rationales.Bags with no owner staying near them: Left without an owner nearby identifies bags whose owners are not staying close to them.
